Identify steps to set up a development environment.
Apply the Gemini API key for authentication.
Explain how to create and send an API request.
outline: Setting Up Google Colab and Dependencies
Configuring the Gemini API and Model
Crafting and Sending an API Request

slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on First Project
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **First Project**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,

• Define project setup.
• Set up a development environment.
• Apply the **Gemini API key**.
• Create and send an **API** request.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
To follow this tutorial, you should have completed **Episode 1**.
Also, you should have completed **Episode 2 of this Module**.

slides.title: What is a Project Overview?
slides.narration:
What is a **project overview**?
Think of it like a blueprint for building a house.
It outlines what you will build and why.
It also shows the main components involved.
This ensures everyone understands the goal.
This happens before you even start.
slides.image_prompt: Illustration showing project overview with blueprint and house icons

slides.title: How to Get Your Gemini API Key
slides.narration:
First, navigate to the **Google AI Studio**.
Locate the 'Get **API Key**' section there.
Then, generate a new **API key**.
This **key** grants your project access to **Gemini's** features.
It is essential for authentication.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google AI Studio interface with 'Get API Key' section highlighted

slides.title: Setting Up Your Development Environment
slides.narration:
Next, open **Google Colab** in your browser.
Install necessary **Python** packages.
For example, use `pip install google-generativeai`.
This sets up your development environment.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'pip install google-generativeai...' in Google Colab

slides.title: Configuring Gemini API and Initializing the Model
slides.narration:
Import the `google.generativeai` library.
Configure it with your **API key**.
Then, initialize the **Gemini AI model** you want to use.
This prepares the **model** for interaction.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'import google.generativeai...' and configuring API key

slides.title: Crafting Your First Prompt: Vague Example
slides.narration:
Now, let's craft your first **prompt**.
Define a product topic, like 'make a new product'.
Then, create a simple, unspecific **prompt**.
For example, 'write a product description'.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'write a product description' into a prompt input field

slides.title: Crafting Your First Prompt: Improved Example
slides.narration:
Let's improve this **prompt**.
Refine your product topic to be specific.
For instance, choose 'a smart reusable coffee cup'.
Now, create a detailed **prompt**.
It should ask for a compelling product description.
Remember to highlight its eco-friendliness.
Also, include temperature control and app integration.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'Write a compelling product description for a smart reusable coffee cup...' into a prompt input field

slides.title: Comparing Vague vs. Improved Prompts
slides.narration:
Compare the two **prompts**.
Notice how the improved **prompt** yields a richer description.
It is also more relevant.
The vague one gives a general response.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: vague prompt output vs improved prompt output

slides.title: Sending the Request and Displaying AI Response
slides.narration:
Use the initialized **model** to send your **prompt**.
This goes as an **API request**.
Once the **request** is processed, display it.
See the generated **AI response**.
slides.image_prompt: AI generating response on screen, showing the output of the improved prompt

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We set up a development environment.
We configured the **Gemini API**.
Then, we crafted effective **prompts**.
Finally, we retrieved **AI responses**.

slides.title: Challenge Activity
slides.narration:
Now, for an assignment, try creating a new product topic.
Develop a more detailed **prompt** for it.
Generate a unique description.
Experiment with different **model** parameters.
Compare the results.
